Entire Research page read: competence centres Wealth Management, Entrepreneurship, Intercultural Competence, Global Innovation, Business Development and Customer Centricity. No actual Ops/IE centre or degree field verified from this bounded page.

Entire Teaching page read. Explicitly calls SGI a subsidiary of University of St.Gallen, curriculum embedded in parent university, courses at bachelor, master and executive levels. Thesis supervision link is not independent doctoral award evidence.
Full substantive institute introduction read: Singapore hub coordinating University of St.Gallen Asia activities. Parent-wide institute selector distinguished from Singapore institute units.

Full substantive Singapore Research inventory read: six competence centres Wealth Management, Entrepreneurship, Intercultural Competence, Global Innovation, Business Development, Customer Centricity. No named local Ops/MS/IE unit. Parent-wide OR institute in global selector is not attributed to Singapore.

Full substantive Teaching introduction read: expressly subsidiary of University of St.Gallen, embedded parent curriculum; bachelor, master and executive courses. No independent Singapore award inferred. Text refers four competence centres while research page lists six, discrepancy retained.

limitations: Current Singapore institute identity and sole imported institution-placeholder assertion resolved. It remains a distinct subsidiary observation, not a fictional independent awarding university or guessed duplicateOf parent ID.
